data.title: Le Bris gives fitness updates on Xhaka and Brobbey | Yardbarker
data.content:
Regis Le Bris admitted that both Granit Xhaka and Brian Brobbey will not be available for selection this week.

Xhaka picked up a calf injury in the warm-up ahead of Sunderland’s 1-0 win over Chelsea earlier this month. However, that was not the end of the problems for the side from the north-east, as Brobbey picked up a thigh injury in the same game.

Le Bris was asked about the fitness of the pair ahead of Sunderland’s Europa League group phase fixture against Jagiellonia Białystok. [...] “They are doing well. Both are in a better place. Being assessed weekly,” he explained.

They want to play as well, but we need to take care of them, because the season will be long. So they won’t be available for this week, but we will see for after.”

Young Sunderland talent Tom Proctor is yet to feature for the club in the Europa League or Premier Leagu so far, but has earned minutes in both of Sunderland’s EFL cup ties this season.

data.title: Sunderland’s Europa League Guide: Getting to Know Jagiellonia
data.content:

However, as our last European game against Dinamo Zagreb showed us, as well as our away game against fellow Polish side Lech Poznań, there are no easy games in this competition. Another defensively solid performance and a win would do our European dreams and good form the world.

data.title: Match Preview: Aston Villa v Sunderland — Can We Pick Up Where We Left Off? | Roker Report
data.content:
Oh, the international windows. Only two things are certain when we take a break from the proper stuff. Firstly, I’ll forget/not find out when England are playing and not watch it, and secondly, we’re talking about injuries to Sunderland players. [...] Aston Villa:Martinez, Cash, Maatsen (Digne), Onana, Konsa, Mings, McGinn (Sancho), Tielemans, Watkins (Abraham), Barkley (Buendia), Rogers. Substitutes not used:Bizot, Lindelof, Bogarde, Douglas Luiz, Bailey

Sunderland:Roefs, Mukiele, Mandava (Hume), Xhaka, O’Nien, Alderete (Ballard), Rigg (Talbi), Sadiki, Brobbey (Isidor), Diarra, Le Fee. Substitutes not used:Ellborg, Cirkin, Geertruida, Jones, Mayenda

Attendance: 42,599 [...] We heard that it’s a different injury and they are monitoring it week-to-week, but there was no timeline discussed. All this lets me hang on to any sort of hope that his name will pop up in the matchday squad later today. So I live in hope, because I’m not sure any striker in the Premier League could have done the job that Brobbey did for us last time out.
